SELECT REC_EMPLOYEE.REC_EMPLOYEE_NO, REC_EMPLOYEE.EMP_NAME, get_global_name(REC_EMPLOYEE.CERT_TYPE_CODE, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) CERT_TYPE, CERT_NUMBER, EMP_TELPHONE, EMP_ADDRESS, get_global_name(REC_EMPLOYEE.SEX_CODE, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) SEX, get_global_name(REC_EMPLOYEE.NATIONALITY_CODE, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) NATIONALITY, EMP_BIRTHDAY, FINAL_SCHOOL, get_global_name(REC_EMPLOYEE.FINAL_EDU_CODE, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) FINAL_EDU, FINAL_GRAD_DATE, EMP_EMAIL, get_global_name(REC_EMPLOYEE.POST_TYPE_CODE, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) POST_TYPE, REC_INTERVIEW.FINAL_CONFIRM FINAL_CONFIRM, WORK_EXPERIENCE, TRUNC((sysdate - TO_DATE(EMP_BIRTHDAY,'YYYY.MM.DD'))/365,0) AGE, FILE_PATH, REC_TYPE, REC_EMPLOYEE.CREATE_DATE CREATE_DATE, REC_EMPLOYEE.CREATED_BY CREATED_BY, REC_EMPLOYEE.UPDATE_DATE UPDATE_DATE, REC_EMPLOYEE.UPDATED_BY UPDATED_BY, REC_EMPLOYEE.ACTIVITY ACTIVITY, FILE_NAME FROM REC_EMPLOYEE, REC_INTERVIEW WHERE REC_EMPLOYEE.REC_EMPLOYEE_NO = REC_INTERVIEW.REC_EMPLOYEE_NO(+) AND REC_EMPLOYEE.ACTIVITY = 1
UPPER(EMP_NAME) LIKE upper('%'||#KEY#||'%')
REC_EMPLOYEE.POST_TYPE_CODE = #POST:VARCHAR#
REC_EMPLOYEE.CERT_NUMBER LIKE '%' || #CERT_NUMBER:VARCHAR# || '%'
REC_EMPLOYEE.EMP_TELPHONE LIKE '%' || #EMP_TELPHONE:VARCHAR# || '%'
FINAL_EDU_CODE = #EDUCATION:VARCHAR#
REC_TYPE = #TYPE:NUMBER#
AVERAGE_SCORE BETWEEN #S_AVERAGE_SCORE:VARCHAR# AND #E_AVERAGE_SCORE:VARCHAR#
GRADUATION_ACHIEVEMENT = #GRADUATION_ACHIEVEMENT:NUMBER#
LANGUAGE_ABILITY = #LANGUAGE_ABILITY:NUMBER#
WORK_EXPERIENCE >= #CONCOUNT:VARCHAR#
WORK_EXPERIENCE = #CONCOUNT:VARCHAR#
FINAL_CONFIRM is null
FINAL_CONFIRM is not null
REC_INTERVIEW.FINAL_CONFIRM = #INTERVIEW:VARCHAR#
ORDER BY REC_INTERVIEW.REC_INTERVIEW_NO
